title: V18 to V19 Experiment P0: Class-4 Calibration Feasibility and Offline OOF Sweep
verdict_summary: Prerequisite per-pixel OOF logits/probability maps were not serialized to disk during prior runs. The existing artifacts contain only aggregate scalar confusion matrices, which are mathematically insufficient to evaluate a logit offset shift offline. GPU inference is strictly paused awaiting user approval.

existing_artifacts.content_type: 1,200 Discrete PNG Masks for Dev Test Set (Not OOF)

missing_artifacts.name: Cached OOF Logit Tensors
missing_artifacts.description: Continuous float tensors of shape [5, H, W] for held-out validation images
missing_artifacts.impact: Prevents offline argmax recomputation with altered class offsets

missing_artifacts.name: Cached OOF Probability Maps
missing_artifacts.description: Softmax probability maps of shape [5, H, W] for held-out validation images
missing_artifacts.impact: Prevents threshold or probability calibration sweeps

missing_artifacts.name: Per-Image OOF Discrete Mask Files
missing_artifacts.description: Individual predicted masks for the 4,000 held-out images
missing_artifacts.impact: Only global 20-scene aggregate confusion matrix was persisted

mathematical_impossibility_analysis.formulation: y_pred(h, w) = argmax_{c in {0..4}} (z_c(h, w) + b_c)
mathematical_impossibility_analysis.explanation: Applying a logit offset b_4 alters the decision boundary between Class 4 and all competing classes at the pixel level based on the margin (z_4(h, w) - z_c(h, w)). In an aggregate scalar confusion matrix C in R^{5x5}, all spatial and margin information has already been collapsed into discrete counts. It is mathematically impossible to determine which pixels in row 0, 1, 2, or 3 would flip to Class 4 under b_4 = 0.28 without the underlying continuous logits.
mathematical_impossibility_analysis.conclusion: Any reported sweep numbers generated solely from existing scalar confusion matrix files without forward passes would be an invented fabrication. In strict compliance with user instructions, the sweep is stopped and marked BLOCKED.

mismatch_1_tta.dev_inference: Horizontal-Flip TTA (2 passes per model x 5 models = 10 passes total)
mismatch_1_tta.impact: OOF evaluation under-reports edge sharpness and small-object detection compared to Dev inference

mismatch_2_offsets.impact: OOF evaluation suffers from Class 4 false-negative suppression

mismatch_3_ensembling.oof_evaluation: Single fold checkpoint evaluated only on its 4 held-out scenes
mismatch_3_ensembling.dev_inference: 5-Fold Arithmetic Mean Ensemble across all 5 checkpoints
mismatch_3_ensembling.impact: OOF evaluation suffers from singleton rare-class blindness (scenes with seahorse or shark had never been seen by that fold's single model)

mismatch_4_resolution.dev_inference: Aspect-preserving unpadded native aspect ratio (768x1024 / 1024x768) scaled to max side 1024
mismatch_4_resolution.impact: Slight aspect ratio distortion in OOF vs aspect-preserving Dev inference

minimum_additional_computation_required.proposed_action: Execute isolated, non-training GPU inference to stream or cache OOF logits across the 20 scenes

option_a_full_20_scene_streaming_sweep.description: Stream the 4 held-out validation scenes per fold through its verified segmenter checkpoint on RTX 5090. For each image, compute logits with Flip TTA, apply offsets b_4 in [0.15, 0.17, ..., 0.35], and accumulate confusion matrices in memory across the 11 candidate offsets simultaneously.
option_a_full_20_scene_streaming_sweep.disk_storage_needed: 0 MB (all confusion matrices accumulated directly in RAM)
option_a_full_20_scene_streaming_sweep.risk: Zero weight modification, zero data download, zero production interference

option_b_stratified_rare_scene_sweep.description: Evaluate only the 5 scenes containing rare classes (Fold 0 seahorse1, Fold 1 sharkFish, Fold 2 ray1, Fold 3 starfish2, Fold 4 turtles1).
